attchmntText: Sintercom India Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Sintercom India Limited published newspaper advertisements for its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on 13th November, 2026. The advertisements were published in Business Standard and Loksatta on 14th November, 2026. The document also contains financial results for Agarwal Industrial Corporation Limited and AAATechnologies Limited for the same period. Additionally, GAIL signed a Memorandum of Understanding with KRIBHCO to explore a gas-based fertilizer project in Andhra Pradesh. BHEL secured orders for Synchronous Condensers from POWERGRID. Oil India Limited declared financial results for Q2.

attchmntText: Sintercom India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the quarter and half year  ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Sintercom India Limited reported unaudited financial results for the half year ended September 30, 2026, following a Board meeting on November 13, 2026. The company recorded a loss before tax of 29,437 thousand rupees, compared to a profit of 11,091 thousand rupees in the same period last year. Earnings per share stood at negative 1.12 rupees. An exceptional item of 29,582 thousand rupees was recognized due to inventory damage from flooding on July 6, 2026, pending insurance claim settlement. Total assets reached 21,31,994 thousand rupees as of September 30, 2026. Net cash generated from operating activities was negative 16,615 thousand rupees. The Board approved the financial results, which are subject to dissemination on the National Stock Exchange.

attchmntText: Sintercom India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding transcript of 19th Annual  General Meeting of the Company.
